newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to import electricity from Argentina - report.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to import electricity from Argentina - report.

text.p: Brazil will begin to import electricity from Argentina this year to make up for stronger-than-expected demand, O Estado de Sao Paulo said.

The paper, citing federally owned power company Eletrobras President Firmino Sampaio, said Brazil would sign an agreement to purchase about 1,000 megawatts of electricity beginning in April. The contract, worth about $140,000 will last for a year, it said.
The paper did not say who the Argentine supplier would be.
Paraguay and Venezuela currently provide Brazil with electricity.
